result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossings on a two-lane residential road. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles, and the wide lane design suggests a lack of traffic calming.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk in the roadway or on unpaved shoulders, creating a high risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the frame

hazards.name: Absence of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or protected areas for pedestrians to cross the road safely.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from vegetation
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the left side of the road may obscure pedestrians entering the roadway from drivers' sightlines.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road near the utility pole

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: This residential street features a sidewalk and a marked bike lane but lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. The roadway surface is significantly cracked and patched, and a tall fence at the corner creates a visual obstruction for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space or priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A tall green fence at the corner limits sight lines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and patching on the road surface can create uneven footing and affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Improve sight lines by ensuring the area near the corner is clear of obstructions and parked vehicles.

result.summary: The environment is a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and marked crosswalks. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles, and sight lines are partially obscured by dense roadside vegetation.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian separation
hazards.description: No sidewalks are present, forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane.

hazards.name: Restricted sight lines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation at the corner may obstruct the view between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the intersection to improve sight lines.

result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane roadway with a bike lane but limited pedestrian infrastructure. While there is a sidewalk on one side, the lack of a sidewalk on the opposite side and the absence of marked crossings create a hostile environment for pedestrians in a residential area.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the left side of the roadway have no paved walkway, forcing them onto the grass or into the street.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible despite the presence of residential buildings, requiring unprotected crossings of a wide road.

hazards.name: Wide travel lanes
hazards.description: The wide roadway geometry and long sightlines likely encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate a safe crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the painted median buffer into a raised refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.
